description: Rebindable gameplay hotkeys (feature: rebindable hotkeys). One key string per action, resolved by engine/input.py + game/main.py's `_binding_key_name`. Pairs BOTH data/keybindings.json (the shipped defaults) and scores/keybindings.json (the player's live/current bindings, gitignored per-machine save data written through engine.input.save_keybindings) - the highscores.schema.json two-location precedent.

combat_speed_1.description: Sets ENEMY-phase combat speed to 1x. Round-gated inside game/core/session.py; the key is a no-op while locked.

combat_speed_2.description: Sets ENEMY-phase combat speed to 1.5x. Round-gated inside game/core/session.py; the key is a no-op while locked.

combat_speed_3.description: Sets ENEMY-phase combat speed to 2x. Round-gated inside game/core/session.py; the key is a no-op while locked.

confirm_purchase.description: Confirms whatever construct/move preview modal is currently open - the same effect as clicking its CONFIRM button. No effect when no such modal is open.

end_turn.description: Ends the BUILDING phase early - the dev-convenience keyboard mirror of the End Turn button, gated by the same Session/tutorial checks.

quick_skip_combat.description: Abandons the current wave straight to ROUND_END, paying no XP for the enemies skipped.

toggle_cheat_menu.description: Opens/closes the cheat menu. Works over the LEVELUP modal, never on GAME_OVER.

toggle_heatmap.description: Toggles the HEATMAP map overlay - the same flag the HEATMAP HUD pill flips on click.
